meta.name: auto-updater
meta.description: Automatically update Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily. Runs via cron, checks for updates, applies them, and messages the user with a summary of what changed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 每日自动更新 Clawdbot 和所有技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望 Clawdbot 和技能保持最新
copy.tagline_en: Automatically update Clawdbot and all skills daily
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Clawdbot and skills to stay up-to-date

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每天自动检查并更新 Clawdbot 和所有已安装的技能，然后发一条消息告诉你更新了哪些内容。
howto.when: 每天凌晨 4 点（默认时间）自动触发，也可通过手动添加定时任务来调整时间。

say.text: 帮我设置每天自动更新你和所有技能。
say.note: Claude 会添加一个定时任务。

say.text: 检查一下有没有更新，但先别安装。
say.note: Claude 会执行 dry-run 检查。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude automatically checks for and applies updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills daily, then messages you with a summary of what changed.
howto.when_en: Triggers daily at 4:00 AM by default, or at a custom time if you set up a cron job manually.

say_en.text: Set up daily auto-updates for yourself and all your skills.
say_en.note: Claude will add a cron job.

say_en.text: Check for updates without applying them.
say_en.note: Claude will run a dry-run check.
